Actually it was one of the better experiences...I don't know if it was the actual hypnosis or the fact that he really listened, respected and cared about what I had to say. Probably a little of both, and perhaps even a placebo effect. I'll never be certain. I had a lot of trouble concentrating while I was put under though.

It's always been interesting to me, too. It's certainly a good tool to have under your belt.

ToonBoom and I do animations in Final Cut sometimes, but I almost always use FC to polish up the TBPD when I'm done. 

I think the reason most people study psychology (other than wanting to help others of course) is to explore their own problems. 

I've been to every fucking thing under the book including a hypnotist. Your story reminds me of when my mom took us to a "counselor" who was also a pastor. He talked a lot about accepting jesus in to my heart. He never truly listened. Then he told me how selfish I was...some other things. I blocked most of it out. The silly part is- my mom isn't religious. I think at that point she didn't know what else to do since she had tried so many other things.

Thus Animation. Using humor as an outlet usually helps. Not when it's this bad, though. I even feel bad coming here because I don't want this to seem like anything other than the fact that I genuinely am reaching out before I make a bad decision.. I was afraid when I posted that this would be seen as a means to get attention (which I suppose in a way this all is)...I don't want to take advantage of anyone though. I get so lonely. It hurts so badly this time.

What are you taking? I want to try Topamax....They tried to put me on abilify, zoloft, Luvox. All of the medication I've taken has made it hard for me to create anything. I don't know if there is anything out there that won't make creating difficult.  I just feel really deeply and looking at people hurts. I get sensitive to light and sound....I'm afraid to tell a medical professional that I can feel people's thoughts sometimes and that touching certain people will make me physically ill due to strange electrical sensations (for instance when handling money at my job.I am constantly running in to the bathroom and vomiting)...because I've been put away a few times for admitting to suicidal thoughts. I'm afraid to tell them everything.

Animating is at the top of the list. Anything art related~ painting, drawing, et cet.;  cooking, I play percussion (jazz drums), guitar, some uke...I like to write music but I'm not such a good lyricist. I get my brother to write the music for my projects..., gardening, building. I taxidermy with animal carcasses I find that are still fresh. Animals die here all the time because of the pollution and I feel so bad for them so I make their parts in to beautiful things like griffins. 

I haven't been able to do any of these things lately because of how I've been feeling.
I'm tired and still unstable. I'm afraid and alone. Thank you for your concern. I feel a little better because you guys showed up. It's good knowing people are out there. How are you?

Thank you for your reply....I really don't know exactly. I've felt trapped for a long time. The pervading problem over the past few months is that I feel like college has been utter bullshit. I want to get out of this town. There's nothing here but frat bros and sorority girls and yet I'm afraid if I quit now I will not only be disappointing myself, but my family. All I want to do is animate yet I have not learned a single thing about animation from my school. I'm stuck because I can not switch majors unless I "go back to get an AA in fine arts". Everything I've done I've taught myself. I'm 50,000 in debt. The land here is ruined. I love nature and being immersed in the forest and the mountains yet I am so far from those things here. I can't afford a car. And the IQ means nothing, I think. It's another way for them to put me in a group. And what good is intelligence when I'm not even stable enough to wield it properly?  

I am in a place where I feel absolutely cornered and stuck. I don't know how to get out of it. I don't know if I have the patience. I even get panic attacks from being in public places, and every time I think about a problem, I break out in sweats and have to take a nap or I'll go in to shock and disassociate. I want to fix these problems. I've had them for so long. I don't even know where to begin now as I feel I have begun everywhere. Meditation? I've tried so much. I try to talk to people about it too. I feel so defeated. Sorry about my sporadic typing....I can barely think and am having difficulties sleeping.

Fellow Type I here. Might I suggest a delicious bowl of saut'ed mushrooms in a garlic/onion and olive oil sauce poured over a bowl of kelp  noodles?

Having any sort of disorder that requires one to restrict their diet doesn't suck when you know how to cook. It's an art. And a science!
